Determines how a document page viewer chooses its display scale.

Default submitter-role colours shared by TmRecipientRoleEditor (which serializes them into templates as the colour of every newly created role) and the field editor's colour input fallback. The values are the light-theme counterparts of the --tm-signing-role-1..6 tokens declared in the Signing stylesheet, but they stay hex ON PURPOSE: they are serialized data — a stored template carries the colour string verbatim, and the value feeds an input[type=color], which accepts concrete colours only. Hosts rebrand the CSS side by overriding the tokens — ToCssColor maps every default-palette colour onto its token reference, so a rebrand reaches stored default colours without touching template data; a host that wants new templates to start from its own palette assigns SigningSubmitterRole.Color itself before handing roles to the editors.

members.name: ColorForOrder
members.description: The default colour for the role at zero-based order (wraps around).

members.name: ToCssColor
members.description: Maps a stored role colour onto the stylesheet: a default-palette value (case-insensitive) becomes the matching var(--tm-signing-role-N) token reference — hosts that rebrand the tokens then rebrand every default-coloured role at once — the pre-phase-1 role-6 colour #ca8a04 (kept by stored templates) maps onto var(--tm-signing-role-6) like its successor, and any other value passes through verbatim.

members.name: DefaultColors
members.description: Default role colours, indexed by the zero-based role order.

items.description: The accessible-name plumbing of one signing step: the shell's title id (the accessible name of every unlabelled input of the step) and, when they exist, the description and validation ids. The shell cascades the context to its content, so a step's inputs (or a host's custom step content) can reference the ids with aria-labelledby / aria-describedby and Playwright's getByLabel resolves every runner input. The ids are unique per rendered step component — the step components own them and pass them to the shell through its TitleId / DescriptionId / ValidationMessageId parameters, so two rendered steps never share an id even for the same field uuid.

members.name: TitleId
members.description: HTML id of the step title heading — the accessible name of the step's unlabelled inputs.

members.name: DescriptionId
members.description: HTML id of the step description block; null when the step renders no description.

members.name: ValidationMessageId
members.description: HTML id of the step validation alert; null when the step shows no validation message.

parameters.name: OnDraftChanged
parameters.description: Notifies the parent that the panel's comment draft state changed. The reply and edit composers hold their text in private fields the host cannot observe through a parameter. Fires ONLY when the TmCommentDraftState value actually changes (value-equality dedup), never on every keystroke. IsEditorOpen is true while the reply composer is mounted (a thread is selected) or an edit is open; EditingCommentId carries the id of the comment under edit; HasUnsavedContent aggregates both - the reply text counts only while the reply composer is mounted, and for an edit it means the text differs from the comment body as it was when the edit started. The reply draft is cleared whenever the reply composer unmounts (selection change, clear selection, starting an edit). Pair with HasUnsavedDraft for polling and DiscardDraftAsync for the discard.

parameters.name: OnDraftChanged
parameters.description: Notifies the parent that the viewer's comment draft state changed. Neither the new-thread draft composer nor the embedded thread panel's reply/edit composers expose their text through a parameter, so this is the aggregate draft-guard surface: it merges the viewer's own new-thread draft with the last state the embedded TmDocumentCommentThreadPanel reported through its own OnDraftChanged callback and fires ONLY when the TmCommentDraftState value actually changes (value-equality dedup). IsEditorOpen is true while the new-thread draft panel is open or the thread panel shows a composer; EditingCommentId carries the id of the comment under edit in the thread panel; HasUnsavedContent aggregates both. Both contributions are gated by the comment surfaces being owned AND mounted (comments enabled, no host panel template, a rendered page) - a host-owned panel template, a comment disable, or a loading/error/empty page reports the closed, empty state. Pair with HasUnsavedDraft for polling and DiscardDraftAsync for the discard.

items.description: Renders a signature or initials signing step inside the shared step shell. Signing redesign phase 2: the form runner renders this wrapper instead of a bare TmSignatureCapture, so a signature step carries the step title, the required / optional badge, the signing instruction and the "appears on" hint like every other step. The capture is wrapped in a role=group element named by the step title id. The shell owns the required / invalid presentation of the step (the badge, the single role=alert validation message and aria-invalid), so the embedded capture is deliberately driven with Required = false — a required signature step shows exactly one "signature is required" alert.
